rules.compression eligibility: E_m(case, protocol) = PROJ_m price < RRR33 price + u AND RRR_m price - PROJ_m price > 2u; compression classes use only eligible cells, empty regime = not_testable_regime_empty
rules.inconclusive: no positive class, and either (a) for e_dyn or price some cells have gain > 2u and others 0 < gain <= 2u, or (b) the sign of the price gain differs between the same-grid and refined truths in some cell
rules.negative mass (strict): negmass_X <= negmass_Y + gamma, gamma from results/verify/roundoff_guard.json; quantity = max over post-initial rows
rules.no_supported_benefit: fallback: none of the above; reasons (gains within uncertainty / equal-state unclosed model at least as good / validity deteriorated) are listed
rules.price_only_compression: not successful_compression, but RDI AND price improves beyond 2u over RRR_m AND price <= RRR33 + u_price on every case/protocol
rules.representation_limited: results/diagnose/summary.json (PLAN section 10 stopping rule, evaluated on development data); only used when no positive class holds
rules.resolved_dynamics_improvement: every test_interp case, both protocols: stable AND e_dyn(X) < e_dyn(RRR_m) - 2 u_dyn
rules.stateful_advantage: LR/LR0 only: vs LM at same m (same protocol) e_dyn(LM) - e_dyn(LR) > 2 u_dyn on every case AND noninferior in price, density, negmass, arbitrage fractions, invvol invalid, coverage; AND the same two requirements against RRR at m + n_h
rules.successful_compression: useful_closure AND on every ELIGIBLE case/protocol cell (Addendum 2): price <= RRR33 + u_price, density <= RRR33 + u_dens, negmass <= RRR33 + gamma, invvol invalid <= RRR33 + max(u, 1/N) AND online warm median(X) < median(RRR33) - max(IQR_X, IQR_RRR33) (cost.json)
rules.useful_closure: RDI AND refined price RMS(X) < RMS(RRR_m) - 2u on every case/protocol AND noninferior to RRR_m in density L2, negmass (strict), positivity/monotonicity/butterfly/calendar raw interior fractions, invvol invalid fraction (full) and coverage on every case/protocol
rules.validity fractions: frac_X <= frac_Y + max(u, 1/N_interior), N_interior = interior points per row x 24 (230 x 24 when not in the score file)
